text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no thermal anomaly detections indicating fires on the property from October 5, 2026, to November 4, 2026. However, the data for the last two days (November 3-4, 2026) is incomplete due to updates not being published yet. While the available data suggests the property stayed free of fires during the covered period, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected.
